question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class expanded Control UI composer modal for long prompts, or handle this friction through inline composer growth/resizing and the existing send-shortcut setting?
rationale: This adds a new user-facing composition mode and draft/send workflow rather than repairing a broken documented contract, so automation should not choose the UX direction alone.

options.title: Approve Expanded Composer Modal
options.body: Implement a scoped large-editor modal with Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, attachment handling, and modal-only Enter/Ctrl-or-Cmd+Enter behavior.

options.title: Prefer Inline Ergonomics
options.body: Improve long prompts through inline growth, resizing, and shortcut preferences without adding another composition mode.

options.title: Decline Modal Direction
options.body: Close the request by maintainer decision if Control UI composition should remain inline-only for now.

recommendation.title: Approve Expanded Composer Modal
recommendation.body: Implement a scoped large-editor modal with Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, attachment handling, and modal-only Enter/Ctrl-or-Cmd+Enter behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They already reviewed this issue and authored the adjacent send-shortcut implementation, making them the strongest available owner for the product-direction choice.
